one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-22. No AT&T earnings (next ~late Jan 2027) and no ex-dividend date (the last was Oct 9). Scheduled: T-Mobile Q3 results Oct 28 (BusinessWire), Comcast/Charter and Verizon Q3 prints around late October (dates not confirmed), which will show whether the wireless price/promo pressure AT&T flagged is industry-wide; FCC review of SpaceX's Grain 800 MHz purchase. Unscheduled but live: a signed SpaceX tower-access deal (Bloomberg-reported talks for ~80,000 sites) would be a third leg of the October sell-off. The stock fell ~16% in two weeks (24.87 -> 20.93) on news that changes the multiple, not 2026-27 earnings. Base rate from T's own history (Yahoo closes since 1995): after a >12% 21-day drop, the next 21 days have median +0.2%, mean +1.7% (n=270 overlapping windows), so I take only a slight rebound drift. Distribution: 85% weight on a lognormal centred at 21.15 with 7.8% monthly vol (above T's long-run 5.7% because realized vol is 30%), 15% on a further-headline branch centred at 19.6. Median ~20.94, so P(>=20.93) ~0.50.

fair_value.method: Driver-led 3-year build valued at the horizon: 6.1x NTM adjusted EBITDA (~$50.0bn, EV incl. $18.0bn NCI, net debt $147.5bn, 6,420M shares) = $21.76 (w 0.5), 8.3x NTM adjusted EPS $2.78 = $23.07 (w 0.35), 12% FCF yield on $2.79 = $23.25 (w 0.15); blended research target (12m) $22.44.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 6.1x NTM (Oct 2027-Oct 2028) adjusted EBITDA ~$50.0bn from the driver build (FY2027 49.2bn, FY2028 50.2bn) = EV ~$305bn; less net debt at horizon $147.5bn and NCI $18.0bn; / 6,420M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Base = average of five quarter-end counts (half weight on the ends) = 73.44M. 2026: Q1 74.50M, Q2 ~74.90M, Q3 75.28M (reported), Q4 est 75.63M (+350k, below the 379k-432k run-rate of Q2-Q3) -> average 74.90M (+2.0%). 2027: +1.1M net adds (vs ~1.45M in 2026 and 1.55M in 2025, reported) -> avg 76.18M; 2028: +0.9M -> avg 77.18M. Slower adds reflect the base rate after new-entrant and price-war episodes (Free Mobile 2012, Jio 2016) and Verizon/cable share gains.
inputs_detail.variant_view: If Starlink/cable/Verizon take share faster (net adds 0.5M/yr in 2027-28), 2028 avg subs ~76.4M (-1%): -$0.7bn wireless revenue, ~-$0.3bn EBITDA, ~-$0.25/share at 6.1x.

inputs_detail.derivation: Base = 67,384 / (73.436 x 12) = $76.47 (a blended figure: includes prepaid, business and connected devices per postpaid phone). 2026: 52,118 + Q4 est 17,800 (+5.0% y/y like Q3) = 69,918 / (74.903 x 12) = $77.79 (+1.7%). 2027 +1.0%, 2028 +0.8%: price actions annualise but promotional discounts (cited in the Q3 release) and a fourth-carrier threat cap pricing; base rate: after Free Mobile entry French mobile prices fell 11.4% in 2012, after Jio Indian ARPU fell ~32%; US 4th-carrier attempts (Dish) had little effect, so I take a small slowdown, not a decline.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Price war reading (ARPU -2% vs my +1%/yr): 2028 wireless service ~-$3bn, EBITDA ~-$1.3bn at 40% flow-through, ~-$1.2/share; bull (+2%/yr, price increases stick) ~+$0.8/share.
Fiber build slower than the 40M+ locations target or AIA growth stalls: 2.0M/yr net adds instead of 2.7M -> 2028 avg 19.6M, broadband revenue -$1.7bn, ~-$0.5/share.

inputs_detail.derivation: Base: AHI FY2025 = 6,908 + Q4 est 2,483 (Q3 2,411 x 1.03) = 9,391; business fiber/AC = 5,356 + Q4 est 1,882 = 7,238; total 16,629 / (12.014 x 12) = $115.35. 2026: 8,700 + 3,020 + 5,820 + 2,000 = 19,540 / (15.41 x 12) = $105.67 (-8.4%: mix shift to Internet Air at lower ARPU and business revenue that does not scale with connections). 2027 -4%, 2028 -3% as the mix shift continues, partly offset by fiber price increases.
inputs_detail.variant_view: If FWA mix shift is slower, ARPU flat after 2026: +$1.4bn 2028 revenue, ~+$0.4/share; cable price competition could take it lower.

inputs_detail.derivation: FY2025 AC EBITDA = 33,579 + Q4 est 10,946 (Q4 2025 adjusted EBITDA 11,236 less Legacy ~600 and LatAm ~223, plus corporate ~533) = 44,525 / AC revenue 112,388 = 39.6%. 2026: 35,920 + Q4 est 11,480 = 47,400 (+6.5%, inside the 6%+ guide). 2027 +5.5%, 2028 +5.0% (low end of the mid-to-high single-digit outlook) -> 50,007 and 52,507; margin = EBITDA / modeled AC revenue.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Company outlook (6-8% AC EBITDA growth) delivered: ac_m ~42.6% in 2028, +$1.1bn EBITDA, ~+$1.0/share; bear (2%/yr growth) ~-$2.5/share.

inputs_detail.derivation: Peer median NTM EV/EBITDA 5.73x (10 peers, range 4.03-6.67x; EV/Sales x sales / EBITDA from MarketScreener). T today: 5.82x on the same basis, 6.24x including its $18.0bn NCI. 6.1x including NCI = ~5.7x on the peer basis (at the median). T's 2016-2025 year-end history (Tickerleague, GAAP basis) median ~6.15x. A 0.2x discount to today's 6.30x on my EBITDA prices the long-dated Starlink risk (long_dated_risks).

inputs_detail.derivation: 149,819 - Q4 2026 FCF 5,600 + Q4 dividends 1,950 + Q4 buybacks 2,530 (about $10bn 2026 plan less 7,472 9M) - 2027 FCF to 10/23 12,880 (70% of 18.4bn, the 2026 seasonal share) + 2027 dividends paid 5,450 (3 payments x $0.2775 x ~6.55bn shares) + 2027 buybacks 5,600 (24bn+ 2026-28 less ~10bn 2026 = ~7bn/yr) + NCI distributions 1,510 - Mexico $2bn proceeds and 1,209 leases x 0.9 close probability (-2,890) + expected Auction 115 spectrum 2,000 = 147,489. Cross-check: MarketScreener consensus net debt end-2027 146,571.
inputs_detail.variant_view: If AT&T sits out Auction 115 and Forged Fiber 37 sale proceeds arrive, net debt could be ~$4-6bn lower (+$0.6-0.9/share).

inputs_detail.derivation: Balance sheet 2026-09-30: noncontrolling interest 15,979 + redeemable noncontrolling interest 2,006 (mostly preferred interests in subsidiaries; NCI income 1,113 in 9M 2026). Deducted on EV legs only; the P/E leg uses EPS after NCI.

6,736.5M outstanding 2026-10-15 + ~9M dilutive (Q3 diluted 6,844 vs basic 6,835) = 6,745.5M; less Q4 2026 buybacks ~2.0bn at ~$21.5 (~93M) and 2027 buybacks to 10/23 ~5.6bn at ~$22 (~255M), plus ~25M/yr SBC issuance -> ~6,420M.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: 8.3x x NTM adjusted EPS $2.78 (FY2027 $2.62, FY2028 $2.82; consensus 2.54 / 2.86)

inputs_detail.derivation: VZ 8.66x, CMCSA 6.34x, TMUS 11.91x NTM (peers.md); international peers 8.4-13.4x (MarketScreener EPS); 10-peer median 10.7x. T 8.34x now (20.93 / Zacks NTM 2.51) and 9.11x 5-year average (TIKR). With the 10-year Treasury ~5% (FRED) and a Fed cut by March 2027 priced at only 14% (Polymarket), I hold roughly today's multiple.

inputs_detail.input: NTM adjusted EPS at horizon (P/E leg, stated)
inputs_detail.derivation: FY2027: EBIT 29,067 + amortization 300 + restructuring 400 + other income ~1,800 (pension credit ~1,580/yr: 9M 1,187) - interest 7,800 = 23,767 x (1-0.215) = 18,657 - NCI 1,490 - preferred 144 = 17,023 / 6,500M avg shares = $2.62. FY2028: (29,634 + 700 + 1,700 - 7,600) x 0.785 - 1,634 = 17,547 / 6,235M = $2.82. NTM at 2027-10-23 = 0.19 x 2.62 + 0.81 x 2.82 = $2.78. Zacks consensus 2027 $2.54, 2028 $2.86 -> 2.80 blend. Not driver-linked inside the engine (computed off the driver build).
inputs_detail.variant_view: If buybacks fall short (leverage 3.1x) or other income drops, EPS ~$2.65: -$1.1/share on the P/E leg.

inputs_detail.derivation: Adjusted 9M 2026: adjusted pretax 13,916 + 4,087 = 18,003; adjusted income from continuing ops 10,563 + 3,616 = 14,179 -> 21.2% effective (exhibits 99.2/99.3).

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM FCF after NCI distributions $17.9bn / 6,420M = $2.79 per share at a 12.0% yield

inputs_detail.value: 12.0% on $2.79 NTM FCF per share after NCI distributions
inputs_detail.derivation: FCF 2027 18.4bn (guidance_check), 2028 19.6bn (2/3 driver-implied 18.5 + 1/3 record-adjusted 21.8) -> NTM at horizon 0.19x18.4 + 0.81x19.6 = 19.4bn - NCI distributions 1.5bn = 17.9bn / 6,420M = $2.79. Yield 12% ~ today's 12.6% on 2027 consensus FCF (19,239 - 1,500) / $141.0bn market cap. Not driver-linked inside the engine.

2026: 16,786 + Q4 est 6,600 (Q4 2025 was 7.1B) = 23.4B (inside guide). 2027-28: 22.8B, upper half of the lowered 22-23B guide: track record on capital investment is on-guide (median 0%), and competitive pressure argues against the low end.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Low end of guide ($22bn): +$0.8bn FCF/yr, ~+$0.15/share via net debt and the FCF-yield leg; a Starlink response or fiber acceleration could push it back to $24bn.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Cross-check: dividend $1.11 (held flat, Q3 release) capitalised at a 5.0% yield, ~the 10-year Treasury (4.96% on 2026-10-22, FRED); T yields 5.3% today

inputs_detail.derivation: 1.11 / 0.05 = 22.2; yield set at the 10-year Treasury level, as telecom yields have tracked it.

bear.story: SpaceX signs tower access (80k sites) and an MVNO or national launch date, Verizon/cable keep pressing promotions: wireless pricing flat, AC EBITDA growth ~2%, FCF misses the 19B+ guide; EV/EBITDA de-rates to ~5.3x (Comcast/Charter-like), P/E ~7x.

base.story: Drivers as set: AC EBITDA +5.5%/+5%, FCF ~18.4B in 2027, net debt ~147.5B at the horizon, multiples at peer median.

bull.story: Starlink Mobile stays an MVNO-less, capacity-limited niche (Polymarket odds of a US carrier by end-2027 fall), AT&T delivers the EBITDA and FCF guides, buys back ~$7B/yr and re-rates to ~6.8x EBITDA and ~9.5-10x P/E (its 5-year average).

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: EV/EBITDA 6.1x including T's $18.0bn NCI = ~5.7x on the peer basis: at the median. P/E 8.3x: below the 10.7x median, between VZ (8.66x) and CMCSA (6.34x).
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium on EV/EBITDA: T's better fiber/convergence growth is offset by faster Legacy run-off (EBITDA negative after 2027), 3.1x net leverage (target 2.5x only in 2029) and the most direct exposure to a SpaceX fourth carrier. The P/E discount to the median reflects leverage and US telecom pricing (VZ, CMCSA, CHTR all 2.5-8.7x) with 10-year yields near 5%; it is inside the peer range.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$16.5 (-21%, near my bear value) the market would be pricing a national SpaceX carrier with a tower/MVNO deal and a wireless price war: AC EBITDA growth near zero, FCF short of $18bn and the buyback cut. That is a fundamental break from my driver path, not ordinary volatility (12-month 1-sigma at 30% vol is ~$15-27 two-sided, but a move that large would need fundamentals behind it).

key_uncertainties: Whether SpaceX can turn ~79 MHz of spectrum (EchoStar ~65 MHz + Grain up to 14 MHz) and 80k tower sites into a priced national service, and whether it gets an MVNO with a Big 3 carrier.
Wireless pricing: promotional discounts flagged in Q3, churn up to 0.92%, postpaid adds slowing; Verizon's turnaround and cable MVNOs.
Whether AT&T reaches its FCF floors ($18bn+ 2026, $19bn+ 2027) while carrying 3.1x net leverage and paying ~$7bn/yr buybacks.
Legacy run-off pace and copper-retirement approvals (EBITDA negative after 2027).
Spectrum spending (Auction 115) and the size/timing of Forged Fiber 37 proceeds.
Rates: 10-year Treasury ~5% and few Fed cuts priced (Polymarket 14% by March 2027) keep yield-stock multiples low.

long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: If it succeeds: wireless service ARPU ~-5% and net adds ~-0.5M/yr from 2028, about -$3.5bn AC EBITDA by 2030 (~-7%)

Spectrum spend in FCC Auction 115 (upper C-band) delays deleveraging
long_dated_risks.cash_flow_effect: ~$4bn cash if AT&T bids; leverage 2.5x target pushed past 2029

long_dated_risks.risk: Higher-for-longer rates: refinancing ~$9-10bn/yr of debt at ~5.5-6% instead of ~4-5% coupons, and yield-stock de-rating

reverse_dcf_check: 6.1x NTM adjusted EBITDA (~$50bn) less $22.8bn capital investment and ~$3bn normalised cash tax is ~$24bn unlevered FCF, a 7.9% yield on ~$305bn EV; at a ~6.5-7.5% WACC that implies about -0.5% to -1.5% perpetual growth after 2028. That is plausible given Legacy run-off, a possible fourth carrier and cable/FWA competition, against fiber and convergence growth.

sbc_treatment.note: AT&T's adjusted operating income, adjusted EPS and FCF do not add back stock-based compensation, so SBC ($536M in 2025, F43) is an expense in every leg; share count falls only by buybacks net of ~25M/yr issuance.

reasoning: 1) Facts: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS $0.65, AC service revenue +6.1%, AC EBITDA +7.3%; GAAP EPS $0.12/0.13 is depressed by a $2.6bn non-cash impairment on held-for-sale Mexico plus ~$0.8bn of employee separation (restructuring line 3,372) and a small discontinued-ops loss (Forged Fiber 37, the Lumen network assets held for sale); a year earlier it carried the $5.5bn DIRECTV gain. Outlook raised for 2026 EPS ('$2.40 range'), capital investment cut to $22-23bn for 2027-28, FCF $19bn+ / $21bn+ kept. 2) The three October drops are mostly multiple, not 2026-27 earnings: Oct 9 (-10.8%, ex-dividend that day worth ~1.1%) = Grain's Oct 8 announcement that SpaceX buys its nationwide 800 MHz spectrum (~$8bn per WSJ); Oct 21 (-6.4%) = Q3 beat but postpaid adds slowed (379k vs 432k), churn 0.92%, promotions cited, under the SpaceX overhang (small earnings-path change, which I put in slower subs/ARPU); Oct 23 (-8.0%) = Bloomberg report of SpaceX talks for ~80,000 cell sites (multiple). 3) Driver build (6 drivers, 87% of revenue driven): subs +2.0/+1.7/+1.3%, wireless revenue per phone +1.7/+1.0/+0.8%, connections 15.4/18.4/21.1M, AC EBITDA +6.5/+5.5/+5.0% (low end of guide), capital investment 23.4/22.8/22.8bn -> adjusted EBITDA 48.2/49.2/50.2bn (consensus 48.3/49.8/52.0bn), EPS 2.41/2.62/2.82 (consensus 2.38/2.54/2.86), FCF 17.7/18.4/19.6bn (guides 18+/19+/21+). The guidance record (EPS 2 beats 1 inside; FCF floors met 3/3; capex on guide) is good, so I sit inside the EPS guide but below the FCF guide where my drivers cannot reach it. 4) Valuation: EV/EBITDA 6.1x (peer median basis), P/E 8.3x (~today), FCF yield 12% (~today) -> research target (12m) $22.44, +7% (plus $1.11 dividends). The P/E EPS and FCF/share are stated figures computed off the build: not driver-linked inside the engine. 5) Base rates (my lane): T's 12-month price change after similar setups (down >12% over a year and within 6% of its 52-week low, weekly samples since 1991 ex-WarnerMedia spin) has median -5.4%, 37% positive (n=103 overlapping); a pooled six-telco sample (T, VZ, CMCSA, TMUS, BCE, CHTR; n=578) has median +5.4%, p10 -28%, p90 +41%; T unconditional since 2000: median -1.2%, p10 -24%, p90 +29%. New-entrant history: France 2012 mobile prices -11.4%, India post-Jio ARPU -32%, US Dish entry negligible; Polymarket puts SpaceX-as-US-carrier at 13% by mid-2027 and 34.5% by end-2027 (thin, ~$15k volume each). Macro: 10-year ~5.0% (FRED), a Fed cut by March 2027 only 14% (Polymarket). 6) Ladder: scenario mixture 25% bear (~$15, vol 16%), 50% base centred at $22.0 (research target shaded toward the base-rate medians), 25% bull (~$27.8, vol 14%) -> median ~$21.9, P(>=21) 0.56, P(>=25) 0.28, P(>=16.74) 0.80. Research was not limited by search budget; X/Twitter and Forbes pages were not reachable (403), and Bigdata.com and Twelve Data estimates were unavailable (credits/plan), so consensus came from Nasdaq/Zacks and MarketScreener.

drivers.derivation: Base = average of five quarter-end counts (half weight on the ends) = 73.44M. 2026: Q1 74.50M, Q2 ~74.90M, Q3 75.28M (reported), Q4 est 75.63M (+350k, below the 379k-432k run-rate of Q2-Q3) -> average 74.90M (+2.0%). 2027: +1.1M net adds (vs ~1.45M in 2026 and 1.55M in 2025, reported) -> avg 76.18M; 2028: +0.9M -> avg 77.18M. Slower adds reflect the base rate after new-entrant and price-war episodes (Free Mobile 2012, Jio 2016) and Verizon/cable share gains.
drivers.why: Volume driver of wireless service and equipment revenue (~72% of revenue).
drivers.variant_view: If Starlink/cable/Verizon take share faster (net adds 0.5M/yr in 2027-28), 2028 avg subs ~76.4M (-1%): -$0.7bn wireless revenue, ~-$0.3bn EBITDA, ~-$0.25/share at 6.1x.

drivers.label: AC wireless service revenue per average postpaid phone
drivers.source: AC wireless service revenue FY2025 67,384M (Q4 2025 8.01 exhibit, Mobility service; equals new-basis AC wireless service: 9M 2025 50,430M in Q3 2026 exhibit) and 9M 2026 52,118M (Q3 2026 exhibit 99.2); postpaid phone ARPU $58.90 in Q3 2026 (Stocktwits call coverage)
drivers.derivation: Base = 67,384 / (73.436 x 12) = $76.47 (a blended figure: includes prepaid, business and connected devices per postpaid phone). 2026: 52,118 + Q4 est 17,800 (+5.0% y/y like Q3) = 69,918 / (74.903 x 12) = $77.79 (+1.7%). 2027 +1.0%, 2028 +0.8%: price actions annualise but promotional discounts (cited in the Q3 release) and a fourth-carrier threat cap pricing; base rate: after Free Mobile entry French mobile prices fell 11.4% in 2012, after Jio Indian ARPU fell ~32%; US 4th-carrier attempts (Dish) had little effect, so I take a small slowdown, not a decline.
drivers.why: Pricing driver; 1% on wsr_pp moves 2028 EBITDA by ~$0.7bn.
drivers.variant_view: Price war reading (ARPU -2% vs my +1%/yr): 2028 wireless service ~-$3bn, EBITDA ~-$1.3bn at 40% flow-through, ~-$1.2/share; bull (+2%/yr, price increases stick) ~+$0.8/share.

drivers.label: Average AC internet connections (fiber + fixed wireless, consumer + business)
drivers.source: Internet connections 11,443k (3/31/25, Q1 2026 exhibit), 12,565k (9/30/25) and 16,248k (9/30/26, Q3 2026 exhibit 99.2); 9M 2025 net adds 1,638k, 9M 2026 1,999k; Lumen Mass Markets fiber closed 2026-02-02 (Q3 release)
drivers.why: Volume driver of the fastest-growing revenue line (fiber and Internet Air).
drivers.variant_view: Fiber build slower than the 40M+ locations target or AIA growth stalls: 2.0M/yr net adds instead of 2.7M -> 2028 avg 19.6M, broadband revenue -$1.7bn, ~-$0.5/share.

drivers.label: AC broadband revenue (advanced home internet + business fiber and advanced connectivity) per average connection
drivers.source: Advanced home internet 9M 2025 6,908M / 9M 2026 8,700M; business fiber and advanced connectivity 9M 2025 5,356M / 9M 2026 5,820M (Q3 2026 exhibit 99.2)
drivers.derivation: Base: AHI FY2025 = 6,908 + Q4 est 2,483 (Q3 2,411 x 1.03) = 9,391; business fiber/AC = 5,356 + Q4 est 1,882 = 7,238; total 16,629 / (12.014 x 12) = $115.35. 2026: 8,700 + 3,020 + 5,820 + 2,000 = 19,540 / (15.41 x 12) = $105.67 (-8.4%: mix shift to Internet Air at lower ARPU and business revenue that does not scale with connections). 2027 -4%, 2028 -3% as the mix shift continues, partly offset by fiber price increases.
drivers.why: Blended price driver for broadband; falls by construction as fixed wireless grows faster than fiber.
drivers.variant_view: If FWA mix shift is slower, ARPU flat after 2026: +$1.4bn 2028 revenue, ~+$0.4/share; cable price competition could take it lower.

drivers.label: Advanced Connectivity EBITDA margin (on AC revenue)
drivers.source: AC EBITDA 9M 2025 33,579M and 9M 2026 35,920M, Q3 2026 margin 41.8% (exhibit 99.3); company outlook: AC EBITDA growth 6%+ in 2026 and mid-to-high single digit annually (Q3 2026 release)
drivers.derivation: FY2025 AC EBITDA = 33,579 + Q4 est 10,946 (Q4 2025 adjusted EBITDA 11,236 less Legacy ~600 and LatAm ~223, plus corporate ~533) = 44,525 / AC revenue 112,388 = 39.6%. 2026: 35,920 + Q4 est 11,480 = 47,400 (+6.5%, inside the 6%+ guide). 2027 +5.5%, 2028 +5.0% (low end of the mid-to-high single-digit outlook) -> 50,007 and 52,507; margin = EBITDA / modeled AC revenue.
drivers.guidance_check: guidance_check: Advanced Connectivity EBITDA growth FY2027
drivers.why: Profit driver; segment EBIT = (ac_m - 15.8% AC D&A ratio) x AC revenue.
drivers.variant_view: Company outlook (6-8% AC EBITDA growth) delivered: ac_m ~42.6% in 2028, +$1.1bn EBITDA, ~+$1.0/share; bear (2%/yr growth) ~-$2.5/share.

drivers.label: Capital investment (capex + vendor financing payments)
drivers.source: Capital investment FY2025 $22.0B (Q4 2025 release); 9M 2026 16,786M (exhibit 99.3); outlook $23-24B in 2026 and $22-23B in 2027-2028 (Q3 2026 release)
drivers.derivation: 2026: 16,786 + Q4 est 6,600 (Q4 2025 was 7.1B) = 23.4B (inside guide). 2027-28: 22.8B, upper half of the lowered 22-23B guide: track record on capital investment is on-guide (median 0%), and competitive pressure argues against the low end.
drivers.why: Largest cash use; drives FCF and leverage path.
drivers.variant_view: Low end of guide ($22bn): +$0.8bn FCF/yr, ~+$0.15/share via net debt and the FCF-yield leg; a Starlink response or fiber acceleration could push it back to $24bn.

bear.story: SpaceX signs tower access (80k sites) and an MVNO or national launch date, Verizon/cable keep pressing promotions: wireless pricing flat, AC EBITDA growth ~2%, FCF misses the 19B+ guide; EV/EBITDA de-rates to ~5.3x (Comcast/Charter-like), P/E ~7x.

base.story: Drivers as set: AC EBITDA +5.5%/+5%, FCF ~18.4B in 2027, net debt ~147.5B at the horizon, multiples at peer median.

bull.story: Starlink Mobile stays an MVNO-less, capacity-limited niche (Polymarket odds of a US carrier by end-2027 fall), AT&T delivers the EBITDA and FCF guides, buys back ~$7B/yr and re-rates to ~6.8x EBITDA and ~9.5-10x P/E (its 5-year average).

guidance_check.drivers_note: FY2028 EBIT 29,634 (+700 amortization/restructuring) + other income 1,700 - interest 7,600, 21.5% tax, less NCI/preferred 1,634, on 6,235M shares.
guidance_check.why: EPS reaches the floor mostly through buybacks (~11% fewer shares than 2025) even with EBITDA below the plan; I do not credit the record-adjusted 2.96 because my EBITDA is ~3% below consensus.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led telecom build (6 drivers: postpaid phones, wireless service revenue per phone, internet connections, broadband revenue per connection, AC EBITDA margin, capital investment). Wireless and Broadband segments (85% of base revenue; engine reports 87% driven in year 1) are computed from the drivers; AC transitional, Legacy, Latin America and Corporate are plain lines. Value is carried by an EV/EBITDA leg (0.5) on the driven EBITDA, a P/E leg (0.35) on my adjusted EPS and an FCF-yield cross-check (0.15); no DCF leg (policy). Noncontrolling/preferred interests ($18.0bn) are deducted as minorities on EV legs; the P/E leg uses EPS after NCI.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) the P/E EPS ($2.78) and FCF/share ($2.79) are stated, computed off the driver build but not linked inside the engine; (2) the FY2025 split into new segments uses my Q4 2025 estimates (AT&T has not published a full-year recast); (3) postemployment obligation ($8.1bn pre-tax) is not deducted, matching peer EV conventions; deducting it after tax would cut ~$0.9/share from the EV legs; (4) Forged Fiber 37 sale proceeds are excluded (unknown). fair_value.value equals the engine base horizon value.
